6.369 rsInvalidSortingContainerNotNaturalSort
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidSortingContainerNotNaturalSort is a critical error that occurs when a grouping specifies
NaturalSort but the containing scope that is bound to the same DataSet does not specify
NaturalSort. NaturalSort is effective only if all containing groups and data regions that are bound to
the same dataset use NaturalSort.
